message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch-only NOP test asserted `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` with `tohost: FAIL 0xdead` vs expected no-trap progress. NOPs have instr_trap==0 but still entered trap handling in cpu_state_ld_rs1. Root cause at picorv32.v:1584 is `case (1'b0)` instead of `case (1'b1)`, so the `parallel_case` match on `(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap` is inverted.",
 "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -1580,7 +1580,7 @@
 				reg_op1 <= 'bx;
 				reg_op2 <= 'bx;
 
 				(* parallel_case *)
-				case (1'b0)
+				case (1'b1)
 					(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap: begin",
 "expected": "tohost PASS with no TRAP: cpu trap asserted, fetch progress through NOPs"}
